sources.title: Wan2.2 (FP16/FP8/GGUF) VideoGen locally
sources.snippet: These Wan2.2 Model variants released officially: ... From finely curated cinematic aesthetics to a high-definition hybrid TI2V model that runs 720P at 24fps on a single 4090 GPU, Wan2.2 makes advanced video generation accessible. It offers both text-to-video and image-to-video support, all while maintaining efficiency and speed.

sources.title: Wan2.2-I2V-A14B-GGUF - AI Model
sources.snippet: Wan2.2-I2V-A14B-GGUF is a image to video model fine-tuned from Wan-AI/Wan2.2-I2V-A14B hosted on Hugging Face. With 79K downloads and 297 likes, this model is well-suited for image-to-video tasks.

sources.title: Wan2.2-I2V-A14B-GGUF · Models
sources.snippet: In Wan2.2, the A14B model series adopts a two-expert design tailored to the denoising process of diffusion models: a high-noise expert for the early stages, focusing on overall layout; and a low-noise expert for the later stages, refining video details.
